g.text: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · 19 input / 32 output · target-only · 256 GiB
Better = upper left. Latency is measured from request start to complete response.
Joint measured frontier: minivllm C1, C2, C4, C8, C32. Large marks: medians; faint marks: all 48 process results.
Filled marks: within-engine frontier. Lines connect measured frontier configurations only; no interpolation claim or confidence intervals.
Each point: 3 fresh processes × 3 measured groups after warmup. Group latency is request p50, then median across groups/processes.
External oMLX/Lithos points are archived earlier runs. Lithos: C1 only. MTP/DSpark and long-context results are not yet included.
